the development of biomarkers of disease and therapeutic intervention.

the development and validation of biomarkers of drug safety and efficacy, the development and validation for biomarkers for the assessment of disease progression and treatment, and the development and validation and application of clinical endpoints for drug development.

biomarkers are an important component of medicine and will continue to be a key component of drug discovery and development in the foreseeable future.

biomarkers in drug discovery and pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic modeling and simulations will be a key component in the future of drug discovery and development and the practice of medicine.

biomarker science has come of age, and it is now up to us to make sure that biomarkers become an integral part of the drug development process.
